doc: Domed lid seen only from above: thin sheet of revolution (underside = top - t, t from the prior grid), a strap (arched handle) over it whose ends run down into the sheet, marker balls. Strap = the largest residual cluster above the sheet that is longer than min_extent*s in the sheet plane. Reproduces hand kit A' (prim_potlid.build_lid, variant fit) with the default windows.
